author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices finding D between the two black keys, echoing skips and steps, hearing repeats, and taking turns, with an old American circle game.

classes.title: Skip to my Lou
classes.goal: Hear the whole song, sway, and clap each time 'Lou, lou' comes back.

mathTarget.parentLine: Noticing the same line coming back again and again

classes.parentPrompt: Sway together and clap twice with your child on every 'Lou, lou'.
classes.childAction: Sway, and clap twice for every 'Lou, lou'.
classes.bridge: The song is a skipping circle: round it goes and back again.

intro.caption: Let's sway to Skip to My Lou
intro.parentCue: clap twice with your child on 'Lou, lou'.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing a line come back again.

classes.title: Skipping feet, steady beat
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap on each beat while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, no more, no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand on your child's hand; tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once for every beat you hear.
classes.bridge: Each beat is one step around the circle; one tap for each.

intro.caption: One beat, one tap
intro.parentCue: tap your child's shoulder on each beat.

games.caption: Lou, lou, skip to my Lou

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each beat.

classes.title: D, in the middle
classes.goal: Find D, the white key between the two black keys.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two black keys help us find the same key every time

classes.parentPrompt: Guide your child's finger to touch the two black keys, then the key between.
classes.childAction: Find the two black keys and play D right between them.
classes.bridge: D sits between the two black keys, like the player in the middle of the circle.

intro.caption: Let's find the middle key
intro.parentCue: touch the two black keys together first.

games.caption: D, D, D in the middle

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding D between the two black keys.

classes.title: Walk, walk, skip a key
classes.goal: Copy short patterns: two walking notes, and three notes that skip over keys.

mathTarget.parentLine: Some notes step to the next key, some hop over one

classes.parentPrompt: Play the pattern, then point: your turn. Say 'skip' as you hop a key.
classes.childAction: Listen, then play it back: walk, walk, or skip, skip!
classes.bridge: Skip-to-my hops over keys: C, skip a key, E, skip a key, G.

intro.caption: I play, then you echo
intro.parentCue: say 'skip' each time a key is jumped over.

games.caption: Lou, lou: E, then C
games.parentCue: Play it first, then point: your turn

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing steps and skips, then echoing.

classes.title: Same tune, one step down
classes.goal: Hear the 'Lou, lou' tune move one step lower, then echo it.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same little tune comes back one step lower

classes.parentPrompt: Lower your hand a little when the tune steps down; let your child copy.
classes.childAction: Listen for the lower tune, then echo D, F, F.
classes.bridge: The second line is the first line taking one step down the stairs.

intro.caption: The tune takes a step down
intro.parentCue: lower your hand when the tune goes down.

games.caption: Same tune, one step down
games.parentCue: Lower your hand a little for the second

games.caption: Skip up again: D, F, F
games.parentCue: Point to D first, then F

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing the same tune a step lower.

classes.title: Your turn in the middle
classes.goal: Listen to the song and play D at the right moments.

mathTarget.parentLine: Waiting for your part is part of the music

classes.parentPrompt: Play the blue keys; nod to your child just before each D.
classes.childAction: Wait and listen, then play D when it's your turn.
classes.bridge: The circle skips along; D is your turn to step into the middle.

intro.caption: Listen for your middle key
intro.parentCue: nod to your child just before each D.

games.caption: My darling: D, D, D
games.parentCue: Hold up three fingers as it plays

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting for your turn, then playing.

classes.title: Partners at the piano
classes.goal: Play the whole song together, the grown-up on the tune, the child on D.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players keep the same beat, so the song stays together

classes.parentPrompt: Keep playing even if a note is missed; nod the beat with your head.
classes.childAction: Play your D's while your grown-up plays the rest.
classes.bridge: Like partners in the circle, you and your grown-up skip side by side.

intro.caption: Let's play it together
intro.parentCue: keep going, even if a note is missed.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping one beat with two players.

classes.title: Skip concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy from start to end, then swap seats and bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: The first line comes back again and again; one line changes

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play the whole song, then swap seats and bow.
classes.childAction: Play your D's to the very end, then take a big bow.
classes.bridge: Same line, same line, one step down, same line, then home to C.

intro.caption: Concert time for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
